author: iProRaids
body:
So this 10 year old mod called zac or something tempbanned me for " Please Keep The Game Calm " , let me tell you from the start, so I was playing a nebula game, and it lasted a long time, ALOT!, and I got frustrated and told zac to end it ( I didnt knew mods couldnt do /end ) so I keep telling him, and without any shit warning, be kicked me saying the above words, then the sr mod came on and told me him to end the game, this guy wanted to argue with me, so I did aswell, I told him to end it, he replyed saying, " Just because I killed you?... " like wtf is that? why would I suggest ending the game if someone kills me? thats just retarded, then I continue telling him, and he said, " 30 Mins Isnt Long Enough " The game has been running for like 1 hour and this shit joined bout 5 mins and he is telling that?, after a while I started telling him again, this zac kid returned and warned me, for " Keep The Game Calm ". I never spammed this shit and the sr mod, Docta, told that im lagging, when I never complained about me lagging, I told him " My computer isnt shit like yours " then he said " Bye " and I got tempbanned for no reason!, and obs this zac kid doesnt even have grammar knowledge, srsly, what is ( Not maintain a calm environment ) it should be ( Not able to maintain a calm environment ) ( Soz for my bad english, I aint american or english )

IGN - jozza05

Reason for Temp Banned - Not Keeping A Calm Environment ( wtf? ) 

http://i.imgur.com/P6NYVGt.png

Why Should I be Unbanned - I got banned for no reason, thats why I wanted to get unbanned

And I never said YOU were lagging, I said a different person (iTerraCubist) was lagging because he was demanding me to say it because he was lagging. You were being rude throughout the game multiple times, not just the part where you said I was shit. 
You decided to say "Idc about der feelings zac" twice in one minute when he said nicely not to call people idiots because it can hurt peoples feelings.
